about: What each measured Octatrack module adds to the frame interrupt's share, in percent of a frame: `use` on each track or slot it takes, `wake` once when it wakes from resting (3 % when not measured; 0 where `use` was read on a first pick from rest, which holds it, or where the module has no ColdFire hooks to wake). The site sends this table with every module set (MWMS v2, sdk/runtime/loader/set_package.h); the base judges every module pick by the frame share it would play at, against mw_frame_line (status.c). A module not listed: a machine is charged its measured meter cost or its price, an effect nothing, and a wake 3 %. Measured with `npm run device -- guard` on a unit, same Part, before and after one pick; prefer a reading on the newest base; on one base, the larger, never one taken on a Part already past the line (50 %), where the guard's drops distort it. A negative reading counts 0. Base-owned: a module's own folder never changes for it.
